entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this supplied technical RPG Maker water autotile sprite sheet. It contains 32 original animation frames arranged in 8 columns, in reading order. Keep exactly the same frame layout and every water/shore outline at the original coordinates. Refine ONLY subtle fine surface texture within the existing water colors. Preserve the original wave shapes, coastline, highlights, silhouettes, sharp pixel-art outlines and all transparent holes. Keep each frame consistent with the others; no added sparkle, foam, waves, shadows, rocks, objects, labels or borders. Do not turn this into an illustration or scene. Do not add padding, crop or rearrange frames. Retain exact 1536x1024 aspect ratio. Original blank/transparent areas remain transparent. Only a conservative material grain proposal is wanted; original structural content is fixed.
